dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: I am Asfand, advisor of the Citadel of Regzar. I am happy to answer any questions you may have.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Greetings. This is the Citadel of Regzar, headquarters of the Corps of Thirty, the Eremites that guard Sumeru City.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: I have retired, but I have been asked by Rukh Shah to be an advisor because I have served in both the Corps of Thirty and other groups.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: If there are any unexpected conflicts, you can call on me to resolve them.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: If it isn't Dehya's friends! Welcome to the Citadel of Regzar.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Greetings. At my age, it's really nice to see familiar faces again.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Rukh Shah and I were talking about how well Dehya carried out the commission this time. Not only did she get to know the young lady of the Homayanis, she also managed to make some new friends.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Dehya is a reliable partner and one of the best in the Corps of Thirty. She does speak too frankly sometimes, please forgive her if she's offended you.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: For people like the Eremites who always have to be on the move and travel far away, it's always a good thing to have more partners on the journey.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Well, it's a defeat in the most unexpected circumstances. One can't see the path to victory when their vision is too narrow.

dialogues.speaker: Asfand
dialogues.text: Haha, it was a pleasure to win.
